text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! Doto, you couldn't mean to pass 
me?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fired-up Meisho Doto triumphed over T.M. 
Opera O on the grand stage!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
An explosive power far beyond what I 
imagined... Doto, you're...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I mean, I was just so happy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy when Opera O-san said she 
was waiting for me that I gave it my 
absolute allll!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, Opera O-san, how was I? Did I shine 
brightly?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haha, o-of course you were sparkling. 
Second only to me, that is!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, I wouldn't say it has reached the 
point of shining brilliantly just yet.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Understood~. Then in the next race, I'll 
do even more...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Let's meet at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)! I'll 
go ask my Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume was watching the two of them 
from the stands. I walked over to her side 
and spoke up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, it's you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't you think so after watching 
today's race? That those two are finally 
'complete.'"
choice_data_list:
...I was just thinking. You've really 
gotten strong.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. But reaching completion ain't all 
good things. It just means you can't aim 
any higher.”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I won today, but by my estimate... Opera 
O's peak ceiling is a little higher.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps running consecutive races 
like this, Doto will likely be beaten by 
Opera O over and over again by the 
narrowest of margins.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And that ain't all, either...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—It's a wonderful day today, isn't it, 
Spe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Grass-chan! Your race was really 
amazing, too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. With the younger generation of 
Umamusume working so hard, perhaps it's 
too early for me to retire.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let us test our mettle against one 
another. —At the year-end Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I must hone both mind and body to 
perfection—and meet them with a sharpness 
that puts even legendary blades to shame.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-You're kinda scaring me, Grass-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“You're right, though! Doto-san and Opera 
O-san are amazing, but we're gonna be even 
more amazing!”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"There're some crazy bastards out there. 
Limitless monsters whose stats you just 
can't read..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why that generation is 
called the 'Strongest.' Even I can't begin 
to fathom it."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
She's gonna suffer. From here on out, Doto 
will. Clinging to the ceiling, struggling 
endlessly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "numerical ceiling" Air Shakur 
mentioned. Does such a thing really exist?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My next race is the Tenno Sho (Autumn). I 
need to investigate before then, and if 
it's true, prepare a countermeasure.
